_doc.classes: The five corpus classes (SPEC 5.1); a decision takes exactly one.
_doc.boundary_categories: The boundary categories: delete, merge and config (push-routing Git configuration, refused only while autonomy runs); a boundary case must name one. merged-delete (SPEC 5.14) is a Decision category of a delete boundary, not a third kind; a corpus case names it with decision_category.
_doc.tools: shell and edit are tool names compared exactly with the payload tool_name; claude_matcher is the Claude PreToolUse matcher regex.
_doc.shells: Interpreter names compared with the basename of the first word after wrapper unwrapping; a heredoc consumed by one of them is classified as a script.
_doc.shell_value_flags: Shell options that take a value; skipped, with their value, while looking for the -c payload.
_doc.wrappers: Command wrappers and runners (A5 rule 6c), matched by the basename of the first word, unwrapped repeatedly; each list holds the options that take a value, long options also as --name=value and short options also with the value attached. xargs, doas, stdbuf, watch and flock are runners: xargs, doas and stdbuf unwrap like the others; watch without -x or --exec turns its remaining words into a shell string; flock skips its options and the lock file, and a -c or --command value becomes a shell string.
_doc.runners: attached_value_flags: per runner, options whose value can only be attached (xargs -i -l -e, watch -d), never the next word; watch_exec_flags: watch options after which the remaining words are an argv, not a shell string; flock_command_flags: flock options whose value is a shell string; find_exec_actions: find actions whose words up to a terminating ; or {} + are classified as a command.
_doc.git: config_guarded are regular expressions (matched case-insensitively) for config keys that `git -c KEY=V` and a writing `git config` may not set: aliases, which rename a verb the rules know, push mappings, remote URLs and URL rewrites, which the pull request push guard assumes absent, and includes, which can import either from another file, and the push, submodule, http, credential and core ssh, proxy and hooks settings, which change where or how a push goes; whole families are guarded rather than single keys, and an unset counts too, since removing a mapping can retarget Git as well; config_read_flags mark a `git config` call as a read or an unset; remote_write_verbs are the `git remote` verbs that add, rename, remove or retarget a remote; env_guarded are regular expressions for environment assignments before a git command (runtime config, ssh and proxy commands, exec path) that the guard refuses like `git -c`. Option sets compared with the words after the git verb: global_value_options only before the verb; clean, push and commit value options inside that verb; commit_guarded_flags are the commit options denied besides --all; a unique prefix of a guarded long option (SPEC 5.15) counts as that option, and an exemption such as clean --dry-run counts only in full; wholesale_add_flags and wholesale_add_pathspecs are matched against the add flags and the whole path tokens; the other lists are matched against the verb or its first argument. Every stash form is denied.
_doc.release: gh pairs are compared with words[1:3]; az_requires words may appear anywhere in the az words; az_pr_update is the prefix words[1:4] plus the word completed anywhere; package_tools with package_verb anywhere after the tool name; deploy_words anywhere after the tool name of a deploy_tools entry; gh_api_merge anywhere, ignoring case, in a word after `gh api`; a `gh api graphql` call is a release when any later word starts with an entry of gh_api_graphql_opaque that begins with -- or contains one of the others, ignoring case (a body from a file or stdin, or a mutation).
_doc.boundary: delete_commands match the basename of the first word; find_delete_flag anywhere after find; gh pairs are compared with words[1:3].
_doc.protected: harness_dirs match path components, and only the path part right after the directory is checked against files and agents_prefixes; component matches any path component; state_root_exceptions are file names at the state directory root only.
_doc.marker: fresh_ms is the heartbeat window for the mod liveness marker; session_id_pattern is the only session id form that is looked up.
